mapper.insert: INSERT INTO seckill_order (activity_id, user_id, course_id, price, status,active_flag) VALUES (#{activityId}, #{userId}, #{courseId}, #{price}, #{status},#{activeFlag})
mapper.select: SELECT * from seckill_order where activity_id = #{activityId} and user_id = #{userId} AND status != 2

SELECT o.order_id AS orderId, o.activity_id AS activityId, o.course_id AS courseId, c.title AS courseTitle, c.cover_url AS courseCoverUrl, o.price AS price, o.status AS status, o.created_at AS createdAt, o.paid_at AS paidAt, o.cancelled_at AS cancelledAt FROM seckill_order o LEFT JOIN course c ON c.course_id = o.course_id WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY o.created_at DESC, o.order_id DESC
SELECT user_id from seckill_order where activity_id = #{activityId} and status != 2
mapper.update: update seckill_order set status = 1,paid_at = NOW() where order_id = #{orderId} and status = 0
update seckill_order set status = 2,cancelled_at = NOW(),active_flag = NULL where order_id = #{orderId} and status = 0
